messages:
maria nguyen: Heads up — starting migration window for release v2.14 now. Deploybot will kick off schema migration MIG_2026_03_21_1 on shard-02. I plan a small canary on shard-01 first.

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Migration MIG_2026_03_21_1 started on shard-02 (job id=48291)

samir patel: seeing PG lock contention on user_profiles (shard-02). avg lock wait 1.2s and climbing. tailing pg_stat_activity.

jonathan lee: can we hold automatically if lock wait >2s for >2 mins? what's our rollback cutoff here?

priya rao: propose circuit-breaker: if median lock wait >2s AND error rate up >0.8% for 3 consecutive minutes -> pause migration and hold traffic. rollback only if we can't clear within 10m.

maria nguyen: +1 to that breaker. for immediate mitigation set backfill rate to low and mark migration in diagnostic mode.

priya rao: mitigation commands (run on control plane):
```bash
# throttle backfill on a shard
backfillctl set-rate --shard=02 --rate=50r/s
# mark feature flag to stop writes for migration-sensitive endpoints
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.internal/flags -d '{"migration_readonly": true}'
```

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Circuit-breaker triggered for MIG_2026_03_21_1 on shard-02: median_lock_wait=2.3s, error_rate=1.1%. Pausing migration steps on shard-02 now.

maria nguyen: ack. canary on shard-01 still looks clean (latency normal). pausing shard-02 backfill and draining any inflight workers.

samir patel: running quick validation query to check stuck rows: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE migrated_v2 = false AND updated_at < now() - interval '7 days';
```

jonathan lee: if shard-01 stays healthy for 10 minutes we can resume with batch_size reduced 50% and stricter lock timeout. else rollback to pinned schema v2.13.

priya rao: rollback runbook (short):
- stop any new migration jobs
- revert migration scripts (apply down SQL)
- unpin routing, restore feature flags
- monitor error/latency for 30m
link: https://runbook.internal/migrations/rollback-short

maria nguyen: executing pause commands now and setting rate -> 0 for shard-02.

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] backfillctl set-rate --shard=02 --rate=0 executed (job id=48292). Migration paused on shard-02.

samir patel: noticed a long-running tx from worker 87 holding an exclusive lock. I'll terminate and report.

samir patel: killed backend pid 91234 (worker 87). lock cleared; waiting for connections to settle.

maria nguyen: confirmed locks released on shard-02. leaving migration paused. canary shard-01 will keep running for 10m observation window.

priya rao: tagging infra-oncall and scheduling a 15m quick sync if canary shows any regressions. adding initial notes to postmortem template.

jonathan lee: if canary fails, we follow rollback steps. if it passes, we resume at 50% batch and keep circuit-breaker thresholds stricter for the next 2 hours.

maria nguyen: noted. I'll update release notes and put this as a known issue in the deploy timeline. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Next automated check in 5m (3612345690).
